markers: [GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Vukradin's announcement of his new band's name and the impromptu performance with Valphine at the Moonstone Mask have created a stir at the Spire of the Morninglord.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The party arrives at the Spire's threshold at dawn and finds clerics at the doors and a large, visibly factional crowd already gathered.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Among the crowd are Lathanderite clerics at the doors regarding the party with open skepticism.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Several agents of Loviatar wait in the shadows, and their grievance is that Valphine's searing sacrament is a theft from the goddess of pain — heresy.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: To the party's surprise, Lord Neverember himself is among the crowd, along with a mass of the faithful and the merely curious, all of whom have arrived very early in the morning.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: There are factions within factions; the ones the party recognizes are not all of them.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The dragonscale armorer, one of the devout, has worked through the night to assemble Valphine's white dragon scale armor and shows up at the threshold to fit it on her, hoping for Lathander's blessing on his work.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The sight of Valphine putting on dragon scale armor causes an even bigger stir; whispers and commentary run through the crowd, and the smith is very proud of himself.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: They can; as Valphine looks around, the crowd sees her gleaming eyes, and Brother Aldric is waiting inside.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Most clerics announce a service with a simple Light spell; Valphine's Daylight lights the entire chamber, and the crowd is pleased and in awe of her spellcasting, some of them squinting against it.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Before she can go to the pulpit, Brother Aldric asks that Valphine come and speak with him first, in a private receiving chamber; he ponders all the liturgical and ceremonial elements she has forgotten, though he is in a good mood.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: In the receiving chamber wait Brother Aldric and several other clerics; even Vukradin's perception notices that nobody seems to be armed.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Brother Aldric wears a concerned look as he opens the conversation.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Brother Aldric is not impressed, and looks a little disappointed.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Before Aldric can answer, another sun priest sitting among the clerics — visibly scarred — interrupts.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric smiles, and it becomes clear that the scarred cleric was there to trap Valphine and that she has threaded the trap; he makes the sign of the Morninglord, very pleased.]
